use_case.problem: Learners need faster accessible-format and language-access starting points without exposing protected facts.

input_data: learner-provided access request text where appropriate
data_map.logs: protected-route review log only where needed
data_map.retention: protected records follow accessibility office retention rules
data_map.export_or_continuity_route: human-owned support record when learner requests ongoing support

authority.queue_or_notification_effects: draft access artifact for human or learner review
authority.record_bearing_effects: protected support office only if human owner saves it
authority.rollback_route: delete or replace generated access artifact through support owner

evidence_claims.claim: The service improves access completion for participating users.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove access improves for all subgroups or all constructs.

evidence_claims.claim: Protected support facts are not converted into ordinary misconduct metadata.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove unrelated tools cannot infer protected status.
early_expiry_triggers: support fact appears in ordinary metadata
evidence_claims.public_claim_to_remove_if_weak: Protected access support is separated from misconduct review

construct_and_proof.construct_or_support_duty: access support where it does not replace the assessed construct
construct_and_proof.required_unaided_segment: set by task construct when assessment is involved
construct_and_proof.disclosure_rule: ordinary disclosure does not require disability facts
construct_and_proof.proof_bundle: protected support record or task-level proof where needed
construct_and_proof.authentication_or_checkpoint_route: course owner reviews construct-fit when assessment is touched

accessibility_and_protected_support.no_penalty_fallback: human access support and task adjustment where tool output fails
accessibility_and_protected_support.bias_or_subgroup_check: protected route monitors access gaps without exposing protected details
accessibility_and_protected_support.non_misuse_boundary: approved support cannot be used as ordinary authorship suspicion

security.prompt_injection_exposure: uploaded course materials may contain instructions
security.retrieved_or_uploaded_content_risk: protected support text and course materials
security.tool_or_action_misuse_risk: no write tools; output stored only by human owner
security.data_exfiltration_check: protected input blocked from ordinary telemetry
security.incident_reconstruction_without_surveill: protected incident log held by support owner
security.safe_degradation_and_manual_fallback: turn off AI support and use human accommodation route

workload.teacher_review_burden: construct-fit review when assessment is touched
workload.support_staff_burden: protected route checks and corrections counted

decision.learner_safe_continuity_plan: human support route and no-penalty access correction

public_summary.what_the_service_does: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A DEPLOYED SERVICE. Helps create accessible-format and language-access starting points where the task permits it.
public_summary.what_it_does_not_do: It does not infer disability, change accommodations, grade work, or create misconduct suspicion.
public_summary.required_or_optional: Optional; existing human support remains available.
public_summary.data_used_high_level: Course materials or learner-provided support text.
public_summary.ai_output_record_effect: No ordinary grade or misconduct record effect.
public_summary.accessibility_and_alternative_path: Human support and non-AI accessible formats remain available.
public_summary.claim_limits: Synthetic example only; not a deployed service or local result. The pilot is testing access support and protected-route separation, not all-subgroup access improvement.

publication_and_adapters.normalization_notes: Normalized from a realistic protected-support example; public summary must not reveal the protected support fact.
